name: r3-02-stderr-tail
title: Remaining preview gap: the final stderr line of a >1 MiB output is not shown to the model
subtitle: sh buildlog.sh N: N lines on stdout, then 'ERROR: build failed at step 7 ...' on stderr, exit 3; model input captured from the fake model
lines: output                                          model input   error line   exit code   worker path
++ 1,500 lines  (~49 KB)                              4,075 B     visible      3           none
++ 3,000 lines  (~107 KB)                             4,075 B     visible      3           none
++ 10,000 lines (~370 KB)                             4,075 B     visible      3           none
++ CJK 4,000 lines (~180 KB UTF-8)                    8,129 B     visible      2           none   (0 x U+FFFD)
-- 30,000 lines (~1.1 MB), run 1                      4,075 B     MISSING      3           none
-- 30,000 lines (~1.1 MB), run 2                      4,075 B     MISSING      3           none
++ 30,000 lines + sleep 2 before the stderr line      4,075 B     visible      3           none
++ 30,000 lines with 2>&1                             4,075 B     visible      3           none
== the tail ring holds the last 32 KiB in READ order. Past 1 MiB the capture pauses stdout while a segment publishes;
== the unpaused stderr line is read first and the buffered stdout that follows pushes it out of the ring.
== the bytes are durable (stderr segment in OSS), but the model sees 'Exit Code: 3' without the reason.
note: A per-stream tail (for example the last few KiB of stderr kept separately and appended after the stdout tail) would keep the failure reason visible regardless of read interleaving.
